title: Fact card: every external number Aarav may quote, one page
outcome: A one-page card of verified external facts, each with its wording rule and URL, so every outside number in the abstract traces to one checked source (D13)
acceptance: Covers SYNTHESIS §2 facts 1-15 plus the RBI FREE-AI spare; each row = fact, exact wording rule, URL, verification status (A-verified or secondary)
Every row is re-checked against its URL (or marked secondary / unverified); no number appears that is not in a cited source
Includes a short 'never quote' list drawn from SYNTHESIS §3 (e.g. exact HF dates, '11 days to detect', 'legitimately held credentials', IBM 241/247, RBI 18%)
Fits one printed page; facts in table/bullet form only, no abstract sentences
